notes: Background music list (0.1.4 v5). Original compositions rendered with FluidSynth + the GeneralUser GS soundfont (free licence; see docs/AUDIO_CREDITS.md), a synthesized convolution room, 44.1 kHz stereo; no Tao traditional song is quoted or imitated. Files: public/assets/audio/bgm/, made by scripts/audio/make_bgm.py, which writes 'loop' (loop length, s) and 'loopStart' (s: the title's one-time intro, or a 35 ms guard of wrapped loop audio on the others) back here. Pick order: start screens (title / party / 搭飛機・搭船) -> menu (0.1.4: a short loop in the title's key and tempo; on the arrival it segues into the title's epic intro on the next bar line); arrival cut-scene -> title from its intro; cultural event (see 'culture'; disabled in 0.1.4) -> festival; at sea -> sea; night -> night; up on the hills (ground height >= mountainHeight) -> mountain; the starting modern area ('startZone': within radius m of 開元港 or the 蘭嶼機場 runway) -> the title's loop (it flows straight on from the arrival; started elsewhere it begins at loopStart); near a village with a theme -> that theme; elsewhere -> default. New village theme: add a track and map the village id in 'villages' (no code change). Every loop quotes the title hook (HOOK in the generator).
title: title

culture.notes: DISABLED in 0.1.4 (Larry): no festival track ships; cultural scenes play the normal location music. The festival / culture loop returns in 0.1.5 (redone with an AI music model or real recordings; parked in /workspace/audio-015/). The rules below stay for then: Festival / culture music plays while a dialogue or mini-game scene of a cultural quest is open: arc in 'arcs' (tatala = boat building and launching, outfit = 尋根 / weaving), id in 'quests' (M4 catch sharing, F2 sharing with kin, T3 boat trees), or the quest needs a traditional outfit (requiresOutfit: boat fishing, M3, T5-T8, IT-M1 …). 'song': true would also add every quest with an activity song. Add quest ids or arcs here; no code change. Cultural consultant to confirm which scenes should get it.

menu.mood: 112 BPM, D (the title's key and tempo), quieter (gain 0.7), no melody: lo-fi atmosphere with a light forward groove. Rhodes maj7 / add9 chord comping (fixed voice-led voicings, top note F#4-F#4-F#4-E4) + soft piano dyads, soft string pad, warm pulsing 8th-note bass, light kit on 1 / 3 + backbeat, hats 8ths -> 16ths in bars 5-8, a small fill in bar 8, pad swell + soft noise riser in bars 7-8; quiet room tone and soft vinyl ticks. Imaj9-IVmaj9-vi9-Vadd9 x2, every pass ends on V
menu.transition: Menu -> title: the title's intro opens on I, the menu's bars alternate Imaj9 / IVmaj9 / vi9 / Vadd9 and every pass ends on V. Wait for the menu's next bar line (bar = 4 beats = 2.1429 s at 112 BPM, counted from loopStart; best at loopEnd, i.e. after the V bar), start title.mp3 at t = 0 on that line and fade the menu out over ~0.35 s from it (bgm.ts segueToTitle() does exactly this). Without bar sync a 0.5-1 s crossfade into title t = 0 also works.

title.mood: 112 BPM; epic strings / choir / taiko intro (kept exactly, spliced from the approved master), then a fresh, open 'new world' bed with no melody: bright piano chords (top note held on A5) over Rhodes maj7 / add9 voicings, airy high strings, soft choir in the lift, sparse glockenspiel sparkle inside the chords, warm pulsing 8th-note bass, light forward kit, room tone + vinyl ticks; I-IV-vi-V x2 | IV-V-vi-I | IV-I-IV-V, bars 9-16 lift, bar 16 swell + soft riser back to bar 1
